name: cob-rag-mcp
stderr:
Usage: cob-rag-engine [options] [command]

CLI and MCP server for cob-rag-engine, the self-hosted knowledge layer for AI
assistants and agents.
There is no hosted service: point it at the engine you run (--url /
COB_RAG_URL).

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  --url <url>               Engine URL (env COB_RAG_URL, default
                            http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --key <key>               Engine key: admin, tk_ or ck_ (env COB_RAG_API_KEY)
  --config <path>           Config file (env COB_RAG_CONFIG)
  --json                    Print JSON instead of tables
  -y, --yes                 Confirm destructive commands without asking
  --read-only               Refuse every command that changes data (env
                            COB_RAG_READ_ONLY)
  --allow-destructive       Offer destructive tools to MCP clients (env
                            COB_RAG_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE)
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]           Run the MCP server (stdio by default; streamable
                            HTTP with --transport http)
  login                     Check an engine URL and key with /whoami, then save
                            them to your config file
  config                    Show and change this CLI's saved settings (secrets
                            are masked)
  whoami                    Show which kind of key is in use (admin, tenant or
                            corpus) and which tenant and corpus it reaches.
  info                      Show the engine's version, which features are on
                            (streaming, transcription, reranking, web search,
                            Content Portal), its embedding and LLM models and
                            whether it holds its own LLM key, its public URL,
                            and its limits (upload size, accepted file types,
                            records per import, question length).
  search [options] [query]  Search this business's knowledge base and return the
                            most relevant passages, each with its source (file
                            name or record id, section, page).
  ask [options] [query]     Ask the knowledge base a question and get a complete
                            answer written by the engine's configured model,
                            with citations and a confidence score.
  documents                 Documents in a corpus, and the chunks the engine
                            indexed
  ingest                    Add content and follow ingest jobs
  usage [options]           Requests, tokens and estimated LLM cost for answered
                            questions, grouped by day, corpus, source or tenant.
  leads                     Contact details website visitors shared with consent
                            (tenant and admin keys)
  feedback                  Ratings people gave answers
  settings                  A corpus's prompt and retrieval settings
  assistant                 A knowledge base's assistant: persona, scope and
                            rules (draft, publish)
  corpora                   Knowledge bases (tenant and admin keys)
  migrations                Embedding migrations (tenant and admin keys)
  widget-keys               Website chat widget keys
  tenants                   Client businesses (admin key; a tenant key: me,
                            rotate-my-key)
  team                      A tenant's people and invitations (tenant key: its
                            own; admin key: any tenant)
  plans                     Plans and their limits (admin key; usage: a tenant
                            key's own too)
  engine                    Sign-up mode and white-label branding (admin key)
  tools                     List every tool, its CLI command, and which key
                            kinds can use it
  help [command]            display help for command
